notes.title: Samorost 2 Joins The First Ever IGF Celebration Days on Steam
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3954149/66c7cbba8bdd4d2b923c36142b3197e85b381e1c.jpg[/img]

The Independent Games Festival has been around for over 20 years and now, for the first time ever, comes a Steam event dedicated not only to this year’s IGF winners and nominees but also to some of the greatest indie games that succeeded at the festival in the years before. Until 20 July, you can grab dozens of awesome games at a discount and even try a few demos, such as the beautifully stylish Nirvana Noir by Feral Cat Den or 11bit’s latest title, The Alters. Samorost 2 was awarded as 'Best Web Browser Game' back in 2007. That was our first IGF award!

You'll find it all on the special sale page: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/IGF_CelebrationDays


We’ve been lucky to succeed at IGF five times with Samorost 2, Machinarium, Botanicula, CHUCHEL, and most recently, Phonopolis. Of course - with the obvious exception of Phonopolis that we're currently working on - all of these games and their DLCs are also on sale with up to 85% discount!

Enjoy the event and have a great summer,
Amanita Design ːmrsmushroomː

notes.title: Samorost 1 lands on Steam - FREE download!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11630467/81a7a037e280a31a4ce5fdb50bc32ea4b2cea66e.jpg[/img]

Surprise! ːsamorost_spiritː The very first [b]Samorost[/b] game, originally released in 2003, is now available as [b]FREE downloa[/b]d on Steam. It is the first time this game is made available as a standalone game, as opposed to the previous web browser (Flash) release. Aside from this PC and Mac release, you can also download Samorost 1 for free to your iOS and Android devices.

[previewyoutube=lEt5oiEcMIM;full][/previewyoutube]

This new version of Samorost 1 comes with [b]remastered and newly recorded sounds, enhanced graphics, full-screen support, and brand new music by Floex [/b](Tomáš Dvořák), the composer from Machinarium and Samorost 2 and 3. Don't forget to share your impressions with us in the comments!

Enjoy! ːsamorost_dogː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1580970/Samorost_1/

notes.title: 15 years later, Samorost 2 gets a surprise enhancement update
notes.notes:
Remember Samorost 2? I don’t, admittedly, but then I was only ten years old when the whimsical space gnome set off on his second adventure. Fortunately, now’s the perfect time to check out the pint-sized sequel, with the developers dropping a surprise anniversary update bringing the stylish 2005 point ‘n’ click up to date with enhanced visuals, new sounds, quality of life improvements and full Mac support.

(more…)

notes.title: Samorost 2 Just Got a Major Update For Its 15th Anniversary
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3954149/bf7a74f364dbe74933cf806724935f15e7ae4eb8.png[/img]

Hello!

As many of you noticed, there was an update coming for a while - and it just landed on Steam!

The new enhanced version now runs in [b]full-screen and with improved visuals[/b], achieving higher resolution of assets thanks to a custom trained AI. Sounds have been revised and often re-recorded, too, giving the main character a wider range of vocal expressions, and more.

[previewyoutube=hCZZP2xMJ6g;full][/previewyoutube]

The list of improvements continues with a new opening screen, simplified user interface, minor tweaks in game design, and achievements support. The outdated, level code-based save system was replaced with a more user-friendly level selection in the main menu. There's also the new zoom feature that allows you to explore the world from up close. One more thing - [b]the game is now officially supported on Mac[/b], and you'll also find it on iOS and Android app stores.

The new and improved version brings:
- Enhanced graphics with full-screen support
- A bunch of game design tweaks
- Revamped save system (no more level codes!)
- New zoom feature
- Achievements

We hope you'll enjoy the little trip back in time! ːmuchomurkaː
Lukas

notes.title: Humble Botanicula bundle launches
notes.notes:
A new Humble Bundle has launched, celebrating the games of Amanita Design -- including the newcomer, Botanicula. The nature-themed adventure title is the standout of the set, but it includes five games in all for paying above the minimum. Plus, true to the game's message, you can contribute to a conservation charity.

The two-week promotion starts today, and you can purchase your bundle at the official site. Botanicula involves guiding tree creatures to save their home from spider-like villains, and includes a soundtrack by the Czech alternative band DVA. The bundle also includes Machinarium and Samorost 2. If you pay more than the average (currently around $9), you'll also get the Czech film Kooky and the Vectorpark puzzle game Windosill.

As always, games are supported on Windows, Mac, and Linux, with Steam keys available if you pay more than five bucks. Instead of Child's Play, the charity this time can go towards the World Land Trust, a charity that seeks to save threatened habitats.
